text: Assumption: Use is primarily at compile time — is this correct?
text_en: Assumption: Use is primarily at compile time — is this correct?
norm: use is primarily at compile time
assumption: Use is primarily at compile time.
rationale: The specification defines CPU_BYTE_ORDER as a preprocessor macro (#define) in Platform_Types.h, but defines no runtime calling context.

original.text: Annahme: Verwendung primär zur Compile-Zeit — trifft das zu?
original.rationale: Die Spezifikation definiert CPU_BYTE_ORDER als Präprozessor-Makro (#define) in Platform_Types.h, definiert jedoch keinen Laufzeit-Aufrufkontext.
